topNeedleMovers.title: links.empty_anchor
topNeedleMovers.description: Internal or social links lack descriptive anchor text (e.g., empty icon buttons).
topNeedleMovers.action: In the WordPress Block Editor, select the link and add descriptive text, or add aria-label='Description' to icon links in your navigation or templates.

topNeedleMovers.title: images.missing_dimensions
topNeedleMovers.description: Images lack explicit width/height dimensions, triggering mobile Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
topNeedleMovers.action: Insert media using WordPress Core Image blocks to automatically include responsive width, height, and srcset attributes to prevent CLS.

topNeedleMovers.title: titles.too_long
topNeedleMovers.description: Title is too long (61 characters) and will truncate in Google search: "ECN Global | Evangel Carriers Network — Telling of His Return".
topNeedleMovers.action: Configure page titles in the WordPress page editor or install Yoast SEO / Rank Math to customize title tags under 60 characters.
